slack-poll.name: Slack Poll
slack-poll.description: Poll Slack channels for new messages, auto-discover new channels, and write per-message JSON archives.
slack-poll.prerequisite: Slack bot token: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN in the job environment, else channels.slack.accounts.<name>.botToken (or channels.slack.botToken) in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json (see guides/slack.md)
